==Acquisition ==
This skill is available while under the [[G.O.L.E.M. (disguise)|G.O.L.E.M. disguise]] during the [[April Fools' Day]] quest [[Annihilator 2: Searing Day]].

==Notes==
* This skill prevents death, regardless how you would die. So it will work with [[health degeneration]], [[health loss]] and [[life stealing]], not just [[damage]].
* It will trigger before any damage reducing effects (i.e. [[Phase Shield]]).

==Trivia==
* [[w:I'll be back|"I'll be back"]] is a catchphrase that originated from [[w:The Terminator|The Terminator]].
